from pathlib import Path
files = [
'packages/components/containers/invoices/PayInvoiceModal.tsx',
'packages/components/containers/payments/CreditsModal.tsx',
'packages/components/containers/payments/EditCardModal.tsx',
'packages/components/containers/payments/subscription/SubscriptionModal.tsx',
'applications/account/src/app/signup/PaymentStep.tsx',
'applications/account/src/app/single-signup/Step1.tsx',
]
for name in files:
 p=Path(name); s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace('import { createPaymentToken } from ', 'import { getCreatePaymentToken, getDefaultVerifyPayment } from ')
 api='normalApi' if name.endswith('/Step1.tsx') else 'api'
 marker='    const { createModal } = useModals();'
 assert marker in s, name
 s=s.replace(marker, marker+f'\\n    const verify = getDefaultVerifyPayment(createModal, {api});\\n    const createPaymentToken = getCreatePaymentToken(verify);',1)
 # Only remove property in token creation calls; other createModal usages are retained.
 lines=s.splitlines(keepends=True)
 for i,line in enumerate(lines):
  if 'createPaymentToken(' in line:
   for j in range(i+1,min(i+14,len(lines))):
    if lines[j].strip()=='createModal,':
     lines[j]=''
     break
 s=''.join(lines)
 p.write_text(s)
PY"

item.text:
Payment token verification is now injectable through `getCreatePaymentToken` and `getDefaultVerifyPayment` in [paymentTokenHelper.tsx](/app/packages/components/containers/payments/paymentTokenHelper.tsx). All five requested components, plus the additional account signup caller, use the new flow. Chargeable tokens return immediately; pending tokens go to verification; terminal failures reject. Polling stops and cleans up on completion or cancellation.

Component and account type checks passed, along with the relevant payment and signup test suites.
